outline: In this course, we will systematically introduce various analysis techniques including UV-vis spectroscopy, photoluminescence spectroscopy, fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance, mass spectrometer, thermal analyses, optical microscopy, electron microscopy and atomic force microscopy. Students who study this course can establish a theoretical framework for the analysis of various organic materials, which will help their future research and employment development.
schedule:
1. (1st week)  Introduction
2. (2nd and 3rd weeks)  UV & VIS
3. (4th and 5th weeks)  IR
4. (6th week)  Raman
5. (7th week)  NMR
6. (8th week)  MS

(9th week)  Mid-term Exam

7. (10th and 11th weeks)  GC/LC
8. (12th and 13th weeks)  Thermal Methods
9. (14th week)  Optical Microscopy
10. (15th and 16th weeks)  Electron Microscopy
11. (17th week)  Atomic Force Microscopy

(18th week)  Final Exam
assessment:
Midterm exam 30%
Final exam 40%
Attendance and homework 30%
